incident-bot: [ALERT] dedicated-pool ventus-prod-1 - tenant=ventuscorp - GPU utilization 94%, queueing rising, p50 latency 420ms (SLO 200ms). Page - oncall-sre-elaine
oncall-sre-elaine: taking the page. joining voice.
oncall-sre-elaine: quick ask — is Ventus on burst? can we spin extra GPUs from burst pool?
sam-runtime: not currently. autoscaler capped at 12 for this pool; current is 12/12. we can request burst override for +4 but need approval (risk: noisy neighbors).
maya-cs: ventus-support on the call, they're seeing 429s and degraded responses for long chat sessions. customer impact: production traffic spikes from enterprise agents, some SLAs at risk.
aisha-am: escalating to sales ops — VentusCorp on annual contract, want minimal disruption. authorize burst if it buys time.
jules-eng: can we throttle long-running sessions for that tenant? runtime can apply soft-rate limit per-tenant while we add capacity.
oncall-sre-elaine: plan: 1) enable tenant soft throttle (limit concurrent sessions to 120) 2) request burst override +4 GPUs 3) if not approved, start fallback to smaller model for non-critical requests.
ops-rotation: I can approve provisional burst for 1 hour. issuing request now: /burst-request ventuscorp +4 60m — ticket #BR-1987
incident-bot: Burst request submitted by ops-rotation — state PENDING_APPROVAL. notifier: infra-leads.
aisha-am: confirming with Ventus they accept slight perf variance on non-critical endpoints.
ventus-support: confirmed — prioritize top-tier customer queries, degrade background analytics. go ahead with throttle + burst.
sam-runtime: applying soft throttle now:
```
api/tenants/ventuscorp/config: concurrency_limit=120
```
sam-runtime: throttle applied, dropping ~18% concurrent requests. latency p50 now 260ms.
oncall-sre-elaine: ops-rotation approved burst. infra-leads granted +4 GPUs to ventus-prod-1. capacity now 16/16.
incident-bot: Burst granted and applied. GPUs online — queueing back to normal. p50 190ms.
oncall-sre-elaine: monitoring for 10m. create post-incident runbook: action items = (burst audit, autoscaler review, tenant QoS). handing to ops-rotation for follow-up.
ops-rotation: acknowledged, I'll reopen BR-1987 for 1hr audit and schedule autoscaler config change with eng-runtime.
jules-eng: filing PR to allow dynamic per-tenant burst cap and safer autoscaler thresholds.
maya-cs: updating Ventus ticket with timeline and mitigation.
aisha-am: thanks team. moving to handoff — oncall-sre-elaine handing to ops-rotation at 1728601560. If issues recur, repage.
oncall-sre-elaine: handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
